name: Good to Go
tagline: Learn to play Go, from your first capture to full 19x19 games.

milestones.title: Build 1: Board, Rules & Stages 1–3
milestones.summary: Go/TinyGo WASM rules engine, SVG board, Capture Go, local 2P, ELI5 toggle, saved games, PWA.

milestones.title: Build 2: Engine, Levels & Problems
milestones.summary: GTG Levels 1–10, handicap stones, Stages 4–6, 150 solver-proved problems + Daily Problem + 1/3/7-day spaced repetition, Monte Carlo territory map & dead-stone toggling.

milestones.title: Build 3: AI Coach
milestones.summary: Gemini AI Coach Worker (/api/coach/review, /api/coach/explain), Cloudflare Access allowlist, BudgetDO ($5/mo cap), deterministic concept tags & output filter, Privacy notice.

milestones.title: Build 4: Online Rooms
milestones.summary: Live rooms (RegistryDO + RoomDO), 6-char codes, WebSocket sync, clocks, rate/action caps, and dead-stone agreement.

name: ThinCab
tagline: Open-source, minimum-viable-cost dual-purpose arcade cabinet and thin-client workstation.
stage: Spec & Cut Sheet Complete · M1 Bench Prototype Next

milestones.title: Spec, Cut Sheet & Provisioning Scripts
milestones.summary: v0.2 SPEC.md, BOM.md, WIRING.md, CUTSHEET.md, PRIOR_ART.md, exact-scale SVGs, and Windows 11/Linux provisioning scripts.

milestones.title: M1: Bench Prototype
milestones.summary: Wire OptiPlex 7060 Micro + Sanwa/GP2040-CE; verify XInput isolation, single-switch boot, and AVD + webcam/mic.

milestones.summary: Run setup.ps1 -WithDrivers + harden-kiosk.ps1, configure Playnite Fullscreen, and capture golden image.

milestones.title: M4: Open-Source Split
milestones.summary: Split thincab/ into its own public open-source repository with build photos and tested BOM.
